conflicts.correct: Alvarez is the 5th unique Astro with a 40-HR season (Bagwell, Hidalgo, Berkman, Bregman, Alvarez) and the 8th such season.
conflicts.wrong: NBC Sports (2026-09-17) said 'eighth player in Astros franchise history.' That counts seasons, not distinct players.

conflicts.topic: PCA 81 extra-base hits vs 81 leadoff RBI
conflicts.correct: Both can be true. 29 2B + 8 3B + 44 HR = 81 extra-base hits, passing Billy Williams 1970 (34/4/42 = 80) for Cubs LHB. Separate Tribune/Hartig note: 81 RBI from the leadoff spot (Cubs record dating to 1898; previous holder unnamed).
conflicts.wrong: Some recaps call 81 XBH 'the Cubs extra-base hit record' without 'left-handed.' Overall Cubs XBH record is Sammy Sosa 2001 (64 HR + 34 2B + 5 3B = 103).

conflicts.topic: Baseball Almanac Rays single-season HR list
conflicts.correct: Caminero 2026 is 41 HR (MLB Stats API). Almanac page still showed 35 when checked.

facts.headline: Most homers by a Cubs lefty in a season
facts.notes: HR 43 on 2026-09-16 vs ATL broke Williams 1970. Only Cubs lefties with 40: Williams 1970, PCA 2026. Not the overall Cubs HR record (Sosa 66 in 1998).

facts.headline: Youngest Cub to 40 home runs
facts.notes: Reached 40 on 2026-09-06 at MIA. PCA b. 2002-03-25. Banks b. 1931-01-31. 49 days younger than Banks at 40, per Meghan Montemurro.

facts.feat: Most HR by a Cub age 24 or younger (tie)
facts.headline: Tied Banks for most HR by a Cub age 24 or younger
facts.notes: Sarah Langs via SI/ESPN. HR 44 on 2026-09-16 tied Banks 1955. Still a tie as of 2026-09-19.

facts.feat: Cubs LHB single-season extra-base hits record
facts.headline: Most extra-base hits by a Cubs lefty in a season
facts.notes: PCA 29 2B + 8 3B + 44 HR = 81. Williams 1970: 34 2B + 4 3B + 42 HR = 80 (MLB Stats API). Overall Cubs XBH record remains Sosa 2001 (103). Some recaps omit 'left-handed.'

facts.feat: Most games with 10+ total bases in a season since 1900 (tie)

facts.notes: MLB since 1900, per Sarah Langs / Montemurro. PCA dates: 06-06, 06-15, 08-05, 08-17, 08-29, 09-16. Cruz 2019 MIN also 6. Scope is MLB, not Cubs.

facts.feat: First consecutive 40-HR seasons for the Rays
facts.headline: First consecutive 40-HR seasons for the Rays
facts.notes: Also first Rays player with multiple 40-HR seasons. Only prior 40-HR season: Carlos Peña 46 in 2007. Caminero 45 in 2025, 41 in 2026 (age-22 season; b. 2003-07-05). Reached 40 on 2026-09-11 walk-off vs HOU.

facts.headline: Second man with back-to-back 40s in age-22-or-younger seasons
facts.notes: FL Teams: second in the modern era in age-22-or-younger seasons. Mathews 47 at age 21 (1953) and 40 at age 22 (1954). Caminero 45 at age 21 (2025) and 41 at age 22 (2026). Spanish recaps frame it as before turning 24; same pair.

facts.headline: First Astros 40-HR season since Bregman, 2019
facts.notes: Career-first 40 on 2026-09-17 vs KC. 5th unique Astro: Bagwell (43/42/47), Hidalgo (44), Berkman (42/45), Bregman (41), Alvarez (40). 8th 40-HR season. CONFLICT: NBC called him the 8th player. Also MLB OPS lead at 1.031; not an Astros single-season OPS record (Bagwell 1994 1.201).

facts.headline: Tied Howard with a fourth Phillies 40-HR season
facts.notes: Paul Casella / MLB.com. Howard 58/47/48/45 (2006-09). Schwarber 46 (2022), 47 (2023), 56 (2025), 45 (2026). Reached 40 on 2026-08-26 at SEA. MLB HR lead at 45. Not consecutive; skipped 2024 (38).

facts.headline: Diamondbacks career triples king
facts.notes: 53rd career triple on 2026-06-26 at TB (10th of 2026). Drew 52 in 773 G; Carroll passed him in 566 G. Career 3B: 2 (2022) + 10 + 14 + 17 + 16 = 59. Single-season D-backs record remains Carroll 17 in 2025; 2026 has 16, MLB lead.

facts.headline: Nationals leadoff HR record
facts.notes: Tied mark also held by Brad Wilkerson, 9 in 2004 (Expos). 10th leadoff HR on 2026-07-11 vs NYY. StatMuse still 10 as of late season. Wood also 30 HR / 21 SB (not a 30-30). First-half HR record 28 vs Soriano 27 in 2006 is a related club mark from the same swing.

facts.feat: Most Giants HR in a season since Bonds 2004
facts.headline: Most Giants homers in a season since Bonds
facts.notes: NOT a 40-HR season. Bonds 2004 40-HR drought still open. Willy Adames 2025 was first Giant 30-HR since 2004; Devers 37 is the most since Bonds. Do not write 'first 40-HR since Bonds.'
